title: Recheck One Persistence Boundary After a Cold Start
teaser: State that survives hot reload may still disappear after the process is actually killed.
message: Create a small record terminate the app process completely and verify the same persisted fields return after a cold launch.

title: Compare a Planet Position Against a Trusted Ephemeris Sample
teaser: A plausible chart can hide a small time or coordinate conversion error.
message: Run one documented ephemeris sample and compare timestamp longitude latitude and the resulting body position at the agreed precision.

title: Navigate a Settings Screen with Switch Control Semantics
teaser: Controls can be tappable while exposing weak labels or roles to assistive input.
message: Inspect a settings flow and confirm every interactive element has an unambiguous accessible name role and state.

title: Expire a Cached Free Entitlement Deliberately
teaser: A stale entitlement cache can keep restricted access alive longer than the product contract allows.
message: Use a test entitlement with a known expiry then advance through the supported expiry path and verify protected actions close cleanly.

title: Record the Exact Input Units of a Calculation
teaser: A numeric value without its unit can be interpreted differently by separate layers.
message: Trace one calculation request and confirm every dimensional input carries the documented unit through parsing storage and evaluation.

title: Restore a Backup Created by the Previous Supported Version
teaser: Backward compatibility should be proven with a real version boundary rather than assumed from schema code.
message: Use a fixture from the previous supported data version restore it and verify migrations preserve the expected user-visible records.

title: Trigger an English Validation Error in Every Required Form Type
teaser: Happy-path localization does not exercise field errors that may still contain another locale.
message: In English trigger required invalid-format and range errors across representative forms and confirm each message stays in locale.

title: Round-Trip a CSV Field Containing a Line Break
teaser: Quoting errors often appear only when exported text contains embedded newlines.
message: Export a note with a controlled line break import the file again and verify the field value is reconstructed exactly.

title: Test a Recurrence Across a Daylight-Saving Transition
teaser: Wall-clock recurrence can drift when a zone changes UTC offset.
message: Choose a zone with a known transition and verify the recurring event follows the product's documented local-time rule across that boundary.

title: Confirm Secrets Are Redacted from Crash Metadata
teaser: A sanitized UI does not guarantee diagnostic payloads are equally safe.
message: Generate a controlled crash with synthetic secret-like input and inspect captured metadata for redaction before any upload step.

title: Trace One Packaged Image Back to Its License Evidence
teaser: Release review needs provenance that remains meaningful after assets are renamed or optimized.
message: Pick one packaged image and follow its manifest identifier to source attribution license status and permitted usage evidence.

title: Keep Derived Numerology Values Deterministic Across Restarts
teaser: A deterministic method should not change because a session seed or locale changed.
message: Compute one reference input restart the application switch locale and verify the underlying numeric outputs remain identical.

title: Return Focus to the Trigger After Closing a Dialog
teaser: Keyboard and screen-reader users lose context when modal focus closes to an arbitrary control.
message: Open a modal from a known trigger close it and verify focus returns to the element that launched the dialog.

title: Resist a Device-Clock Rollback in Usage Accounting
teaser: Local clock changes should not grant extra restricted usage when accounting relies on trusted time.
message: Exercise a supported usage-limit test then roll the device clock backward and confirm the stored allowance does not increase.

title: Inspect a PDF Table That Spans Multiple Pages
teaser: Tables can lose headers or row meaning when they cross a page boundary.
message: Generate a long report and verify repeated headers row order and cell alignment remain understandable on every continued page.

title: Use Canonical Theme Tags Behind Localized Labels
teaser: Localized display text should not become a different storage key for the same content category.
message: Inspect one Turkish and English theme label and confirm both map to the same documented canonical tag in stored content.

title: Interrupt a Background Write During App Suspension
teaser: Lifecycle suspension can expose partially committed data if transactional boundaries are weak.
message: Start a controlled write trigger suspension at the designated test point and verify restart observes either the old state or the complete new state.

title: Search for a Name with Case and Diacritic Variants
teaser: Users expect documented normalization rules to behave consistently across visually related spellings.
message: Create a small fixture with case and diacritic variants then verify search returns exactly the matches promised by the normalization contract.

title: Reject an Impossible Gregorian Date Before Calculation
teaser: A parser that accepts formatted nonsense can push invalid values deep into the engine.
message: Submit a date that matches the text pattern but cannot exist in the Gregorian calendar and verify validation stops the request early.

title: Abort a Restore Without Mutating the Existing Profile
teaser: Failure handling is unsafe if validation begins writing before the archive is proven usable.
message: Attempt restore with a deliberately invalid fixture and verify record counts hashes or selected fields remain unchanged afterward.

title: Verify Decimal Precision at a Serialization Boundary
teaser: A correct in-memory value can drift when converted to text or a lower-precision storage type.
message: Choose a precision-sensitive test value serialize and reload it then compare against the documented tolerance or exact representation.

title: Open the Correct Entity from Two Similar Notifications
teaser: Notification routing needs stable identifiers rather than titles that may collide.
message: Create two records with similar labels send test notifications and confirm each action resolves to its own exact entity identifier.

title: Ensure a Free Preview Does Not Embed the Full Premium Payload
teaser: Hiding premium text visually is insufficient if the protected payload is already delivered to the client.
message: Inspect a Free preview path and verify only contractually allowed preview data reaches the render or accessibility surface.

title: Preserve an Unsaved Draft During a Supported Locale Switch
teaser: Rebuilding localized widgets should not silently discard user work.
message: Enter a draft change switch locale through the supported flow and confirm the draft survives or a documented confirmation protects it.

title: Sanitize Export Filenames Derived from User Text
teaser: Untrusted titles can introduce reserved characters or unsafe path fragments.
message: Export a report whose title contains reserved characters and verify the generated filename follows the platform-safe normalization rule.

title: Label a Truncated Chart Axis Clearly
teaser: A shortened scale can communicate a false visual magnitude when its baseline is not obvious.
message: Review one chart with a nonzero baseline and confirm the scale choice and labels make the truncation explicit and defensible.

title: Prove Every Date Appears Once in a Monthly Shard
teaser: Row counts alone cannot detect a missing day paired with a duplicate day.
message: Parse one monthly shard and verify the date set is continuous with no gaps and every expected date occurs exactly once.

title: Replace Raw Service Errors with Stable User Messages
teaser: Backend details can leak architecture while still failing to tell the user what action is possible.
message: Trigger a controlled service failure and confirm the visible copy omits stack traces internal endpoints and tokens while offering a safe next step.

title: Honor Reduced-Motion Preference in a Core Transition
teaser: Accessibility preferences should affect meaningful motion rather than only decorative effects.
message: Enable reduced motion perform a primary navigation transition and verify the animation is removed or simplified according to policy.

title: Recompute the Release Checksum Outside the Build Step
teaser: A checksum generated by the same flawed pipeline offers weaker independent evidence.
message: Hash the exact artifact in a separate verification step and compare it byte-for-byte with the provenance checksum recorded for release.

title: Close July with a Reproducible Handoff
teaser: A vague note makes the next validation cycle spend time rediscovering state.
message: Record the highest-priority open item with its exact requirement file test or artifact reference and the next command or check needed.
